verdict.rationale: Jina Reader offers semantic markdown chunking (x-markdown-chunking) and token-limit trimming (x-max-tokens), which directly address fitting large content within processing limits, plus general table/PDF extraction via markdown conversion. However, there's no table-specific chunking logic or evidence of handling very large tables distinctly from generic page content. Missing for 10: table-specific extraction/chunking strategy, benchmarks or examples showing large-table handling, independent verification of chunking quality on tabular data.
